provenance.merged: develop's first-parent commits whose subject ends in (#N), committer time in [2026-11-12T00:00Z, 2026-11-14T00:00Z), read with git log on 2026-11-14. The committer time of a squash merge can differ from gh's mergedAt by about a second (design W2: #4340 10:59:22 JST, git 10:59:21). Commits without (#N) (the release commits of v0.51.0 on 2026-11-12 JST and v0.51.1) are not in it.
provenance.created: the earliest orchestrate run-log record `stage: pr` with note `pr=#N created` per PR (workspace/orchestration/runs/*/run-*.jsonl), its `at` in [2026-11-12T00:00Z, 2026-11-14T00:00Z). `at` is written after `gh pr create` returns, so it is at or just after createdAt. The 2026-11-12 JST part is outside the window and its coverage was not checked.
